version.reason: The EVM target is what decides whether the name is reserved, so iterating targets shows both sides of the Cancun boundary.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: solc 0.8.36 declines the Frontier target outright, which the runner counts as a rejection, while slang accepts the declaration.

Before Cancun solc accepts the declaration with only a warning ('mcopy' will be promoted to Yul reserved identifier in the future), which the runner counts as a rejection. slang correctly accepts it, so the statuses differ until warnings are distinguished from errors.
